correctness.rationale: For A=diag(1,c tau,0,0), c in (0,1), 0<tau<1/sqrt(2), the first accepted b=2 Gaussian sketch spans exactly the rank-two range almost surely; first unpivoted QR vector is (X,delta Y), delta=c tau. Direct orthonormal complement gives row squared norms w1^2=(X^2+delta^4 Y^2)/D, w2^2=delta^2(X^2+Y^2)/D. With Z=delta^2Y^2/D, both rows retained exactly for t<Z<1-t; Y/X Cauchy gives explicit two-arctan P0. Excluding initial premature stopping changes probability by at most 1-exp(-tau^2) using chi-square(2); therefore limit is 2 arcsin(c)/pi. SVD of already formed B recovers rank-one error delta<tau. Independently checked QR, Cauchy probability against 36,000 Gaussian samples across three tau/c cases; source MATLAB code independently read to confirm exact pruning and 4x4 cap. Sampling not infinite proof.
